what_happened.line: Finance Committee agreed to begin FY27 budget drafting by September, months earlier than the usual January-to-April push.
The next two meetings will be dedicated to hearing budget expectations from the incoming town manager and new superintendent.
Members said combining the town hall, Marshall Park, and override articles on one FY26 warrant put too many large asks in front of voters at once.
The committee approved minutes from three earlier meetings and took no other votes before adjourning.
The next Finance Committee meeting was set for May 22.

why_it_matters: An earlier FY27 drafting timeline is meant to give residents and other boards more time to review budget numbers before they reach Town Meeting.
How multiple funding requests are grouped on a warrant affects how voters weigh them, a lesson members drew from the FY26 override vote.
Early meetings with the new town manager and superintendent will shape assumptions on health insurance, salaries, and the Turkey Hill school project that later feed the FY27 budget.
